body_html:
The Global Stream armless chair brings clean, contoured design to high-traffic spaces where seating has to work hard and tuck away fast. Its one-piece polypropylene seat and back wipe clean in seconds, while the anatomical contouring delivers genuine support through a long wait or a full training session. When the room turns over, it stacks up to five high on the floor or fifteen high on a dolly, freeing the floor in moments.

Features

  • Armless multi-purpose stacking chair designed by Richard Douglas Rose
  • Durable, easy-to-clean polypropylene seat and back shell available in 14 designer colours
  • Anatomically contoured seat and back provide even support without pressure points
  • Non-marking nylon bullet glides colour-matched to the shell; optional casters available
  • Stacks up to 5 high on the floor or 15 high on the optional transport dolly (2085)
  • Rated for single-shift commercial use by users up to 300 lbs

Specifications

Overall dimensions 20.5"W x 25"D x 33.25"H. Steel frame with three finish options and colour-matched glides. Tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards and backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty on the frame and structural components. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group.

As a family-owned Canadian dealer since 1964, Brant Business Interiors helps school boards, healthcare facilities and municipalities outfit waiting rooms and multi-use spaces with confidence — and as an OECM-eligible supplier, Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote or call 1-800-835-9565 for volume pricing and colour matching.
